title: Presentations of Galois groups of unramified extensions of global fields and its predicted distribution
summary: Motivated by the work of Liu, we study certain canonical quotients of $G_{\emptyset}^T(K)$ -- the Galois group of the maximal unramified extension of a global field $K$ that is split completely at a finite nonempty set of places in $T$ -- for $Γ$-extensions $K/Q$, and prove they have presentations of a particular form. This presentation leads us to the construction of a new random group model as in the work of Liu, Wood, and Zureick-Brown that predicts the distribution of $G_{\emptyset}^T(K)$ as we vary among $Γ$-extensions $K/Q$ with prescribed local conditions at places in $T$, giving a…
